desc: Replace the full markdown content of a plan canvas attached to a code channel.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `code_channels:manage` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel.desc: ID of the agent session channel the canvas is attached to.

canvas_id.desc: Encoded ID of the canvas whose content to replace.

content.desc: The full new canvas content as markdown. The server diffs this against the current content and applies only the changed sections.

canvas_id.desc: The encoded ID of the updated canvas.

sections_changed_count.desc: Number of section-level edit operations applied (replaced + inserted + deleted). Zero when the new content was identical to the current content.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.

not_agent_channel.desc: The specified channel is not an agent session channel.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The set-canvas-content feature is not enabled for this user.

not_authorized.desc: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.

canvas_not_found.desc: The specified canvas_id does not correspond to a canvas you can access.

content_too_large.desc: The provided content exceeds the maximum canvas size.

too_many_sections.desc: The provided content or the existing canvas has too many sections to diff. Reduce the number of distinct blocks (paragraphs, headings, code fences) in the document.

canvas_content_fetch_failed.desc: The canvas's current content could not be read to compute the diff.

canvas_content_update_failed.desc: The canvas content could not be updated.
